About this list and its data sources

15,153 entries parsed from the official DBS/POSB PayLah! Saturday Savings merchant PDF (dated per the file's metadata). Heartland-shop rows include a direct postal code per merchant. Hawker centre, wet market, coffeeshop, and industrial-canteen rows show the postal code of the building — individual stall unit numbers are best-effort and a small number may be misparsed due to PDF text wrapping. When it matters, cross-check with DBS's original PDF or in-app list.

Nearest MRT/LRT tags are Claude's own approximation, mapped from the DBS document's area groupings to nearby stations on Singapore's currently operating lines — this is not in the source PDF, which never mentions MRT stations. It's a rough proximity guide (area-level, not per-merchant), so don't treat it as a walking-distance guarantee, especially for large areas like "Jurong" or "Raffles Place, Marina, Cecil, People's Park" that span many stations.
